notes: UI-audit batch 1 (v1.11.41 — audit §16 items 1–6, 8–10; item 7 mobile skipped, app is desktop-only): (1) all modals capped at 90vh with an internal-scrolling body and a sticky footer, so Save/Confirm is always visible; (2) Esc closes every modal, Tab is trapped inside, role="dialog" + aria-modal, focus returns to the opener, accessible labels on the six close buttons; (3) toast feedback (~2s, bottom) for done/saved/backup/sync plus a distinct not-saved error state — the topbar saved pill stays; (4) Jalali date + 24h time text inputs (Persian digits accepted) in edit box, edit exam, add assignment and the Analytics filters incl. period comparison — storage stays Gregorian ISO; (5) Dashboard is a real summary: 4 KPI cards + a one-line today + the next 3 days summarised, the 7-day detail list is gone; (6) the three near-identical hours-per-day charts merged into the one grouped planned/actual/useful chart (Pvu card), and tall-bar value labels now go inside the bar instead of being clipped at the SVG top; (8) Exams layout inverted — the groups are the main content in the wide pane, the big dashed empty box is gone; (9) subject delete asks «حذف درس؟» and offers a 5-second Undo; (10) «گذشته» undone list grouped by day (collapsible) with a subject filter + search. 25 new i18n keys (1214/1214).
